explanations.3: The 'local' keyword makes this variable only exist inside this function, so it won't affect the shell environment outside.
explanations.5: The '-z' flag checks if the string is empty (has zero length); this validates that the user actually provided a variable name.
explanations.11: This tells ripgrep (rg) to treat files matching the pattern as 'config' type, even though ripgrep doesn't normally know about .env or .cfg files.
